title: Refund to full price, written in words alone.
technique: Every shot written in plain text; references only for faces, voices, studio and screens.
story: A bikini store owner gets a refund and decides it is time for a discount.
Scout, a floating lime orb, freezes the moment just before she saves it.
It shows her a past call: a shopper who left a bikini in her cart three times.
The shopper says there is a discount every week, so she just waits.
The owner drops the discount. Days later the bikini sells at full price.
End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.

shots.what: Her phone on the packing table; a refund notification slides in
She snatches up the phone, bikini rails behind her
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: She looks into the lens, a coral bikini in hand
shots.line: Sales are so low this week.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: From behind, she types on the Shopify discount page
shots.line: Maybe it's time for a discount.
shots.speaker: Owner (inner)

shots.what: Time freezes over Save discount; the lime orb fades in
shots.line: Not yet. There's something you don't know.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: She looks at the orb; a past call appears inside it
shots.line: I called one of your shoppers.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: Inside the memory: the shopper packs a beach bag, call card floating
shots.line: Sunset bikini, in your cart three times. What stopped you?
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: She folds a towel into the bag without looking up
shots.line: There's a discount every week. I just wait.
shots.speaker: Shopper

shots.what: Back at her laptop, she laughs at herself and clicks Discard
shots.line: I'm training them to wait. Noted.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Days later she packs the bikini; a full-price order arrives
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: The studio fades; the orb becomes the 'o' of Scout
